items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: He got me a tour of Germany this year I think it was, or last year.

ctx.x: Do you work with Russ Dantzler, out of New York?
Yeah, Russ, yeah. He got me a tour of Germany this year I think it was, or last year.
Well you’re in good company with him. He’s got Benny Waters.
